scenario.brief: Priya has opened a pull request for a small books API. It works on her laptop. Your job: decide whether it is safe to ship.
scenario.role: Senior engineer reviewing a teammate's pull request.
scenario.goal: Find what must change before this goes to production, and say why.
rules: Priya is in the chat. She answers questions about her code.
Ask about anything: auth, errors, limits, configuration.
When you are ready, press End and debrief.
scenario.artifactNote: 45 lines, in memory, no tests yet. Read it top to bottom, like a reviewer.
